title: Truffle Oil
wikitext:
{{Infobox |eng = Truffle Oil |source = [[Artisan Goods]] • [[Desert Festival]] • [[Truffle Crab]]s • [[Traveling Cart]] |ingredients = {{Name|Truffle|1}} |edibility = 15 |sellprice = 1065 |quality = false |craftingstation = {{Name|Oil Maker}} |crafttime = 360m (6h) }} '''Truffle Oil''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made in the [[Oil Maker]] from a [[Truffle]], taking 6 hours to produce. It can also be dropped from [[Truffle Crab]]s. One may be purchased from [[Marnie]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|50|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. Occasionally the [[Traveling Cart]] will offer it in her rotating stock. Despite being listed as "A gourmet cooking ingredient" there are no cooking recipes that use it, but it is used to make the [[Rain Totem]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |hate=Sebastian,Jas,Vincent |love=Harvey }} ==Bundles== Truffle Oil is an option for the {{Bundle|Artisan||y}}. ==Crafting== Truffle Oil is used to make the following items: {{Recipes|header|hide=restores,buff,duration}} {{:Rain Totem|RecipeRow/NoBuffsHealthEnergy}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Notes== Without the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Artisan Profession]], iridium quality [[Truffle|truffles]] are worth more to sell outright rather than turn into oil. ==Tailoring== Truffle Oil can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt262a.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Dark Bandana Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *Mayor [[Lewis]] requests Truffle Oil by mail on the 21st of [[Summer]] (year 2) in the [[Quests#Mayor's Need|"Mayor's Need" Quest]]. The reward is {{Price|750}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
Note that Lewis will send the letter triggering the quest regardless of whether or not the player owns a [[pig]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.6|Now dropped by [[Truffle Crab]]s.
